task.task_name: Recursive security scan with explicit coverage
task.description: Implement AFC17 and security completeness portionAFC05 from T7 RED and policies. CLI scan accepts a file or recursive directory by default, flags --recursive, --max-files, --max-bytes, explicit exclusions. Walk narrow authorized scope, internal symlinks only, canonical identities visited once, no cycles, bound directories/depth/count/bytes; refuse external targets, never leak external names/content. Use shared readContainedFile descriptor reader after T18 identity fix. Capture declared scope/excludes/limits before traversal; preserve all valid findings when another file is unavailable/denied/limited. coverage:{status,required,reasons}, files:[{path,status,reason?}] additive; scan report FAIL dominates finding threshold but coverage incomplete remains. Missing required source/report and parser/execution failure must not be called PASS. Propagate incomplete through CLI/gate/service/report/schema consumers and tell root about outside ownership adapter unions. Keep root-added service validateSerializedOutput and redact integration intact. No guard/output-validation/detector changes; root owns these. Use path-scan module to avoid command/service monolith and avoid import cycles. Security service.check error should be incomplete rather than fabricated pass if touching that path, inform root for guard strict rejection.
acceptance_criteria: Nested directory default recursion, internal symlink canonical duplicate once, cycle termination.
Denied/unreadable/limit yields incomplete required coverage without dropping already established findings or exposing unauthorized target names.
File and directory CLI/runtime reports include declared scope/exclusions/limits and per-file scanned/skipped/failed outcomes; matching gate/exit statuses truthful.
task.module_patterns: Deterministic security boundary, preserve public compatibility except approved fixes, fail closed with typed constant errors.
